title: Consciousness depends only on the present state

statements.text: When local-state sufficiency and causal efficacy hold, consciousness attribution cannot depend irreducibly on prior history: with $X_t$ fixed, the attribution is the same across every history $X_{<t}$, so it must be state-based, $C_t = f(X_t)$.

sources.quote: when 𝑋𝑡 is held constant between realizations, the general attribution function is identical across all histories
Consciousness must therefore be attributed to a system’s present state rather than to its past states.
